hero.caption: A locomotive hauled Belfast-Dublin 'Enterprise' service awaits departure, propelled by IÉ 201 class Abhainn na Life / River Liffey. All Belfast-Dublin services moved from Lanyon Place station when Grand Central opened; services were also increased to hourly from bihourly. To accommodate the increase in services, a variety of rolling stock from IÉ and NIR is used.

images.filename: Belfast Grand Central Station Busway Bridge.png
images.caption:
An image taken on 15/02/2023 of Belfast Grand Central Station's 'Busway Bridge'. This bridge when completed, will allow busses to leave the bus bays at the new station, cross over the new 3 track wide line and enter the slip road that will take them onto the M1 'Westlink'. 
Translink have slated this bridge to be completed by the end of 2023, but as it currently stands  the bridge has resumed construction after a pause of a few months with the bridge ramps being further constructed whilst retaining wall between the sliproad and M1 'Westlink' has been given fresh red brickwork.
images.alt:
An image taken on 15/02/2023 of Belfast Grand Central Station's 'Busway Bridge'. This bridge when completed, will allow busses to leave the bus bays at the new station, cross over the new 3 track wide line and enter the slip road that will take them onto the M1 'Westlink'. 
Translink have slated this bridge to be completed by the end of 2023, but as it currently stands  the bridge has resumed construction after a pause of a few months with the bridge ramps being further constructed whilst retaining wall between the sliproad and M1 'Westlink' has been given fresh red brickwork.

images.caption:
A zoomed in image of Belfast Grand Central Station's construction progress. 
This image shows the inner workings of the metal structure as well as many cranes and cherrypickers doing all sorts of construction work. 

An interesting thing to note is that the second floor of the building seems to have been completed as there is a concrete staircae just about visible behind the white crane to the left of the image.
